subject: Civic Education
competence: Names the public services provided for the area identifying them.
unique_learning_outcome: Names the public services provided for the area identifying them.
Describes institutions that provide public services and the functions of the officers.
Presents information about other public services provided by the government.
Gives examples for other organizations that provide public services.
Expresses ideas appreciating the fact that public services bring about a quality development of human lives.
the_entrance: Let's explore the public services provided in our area and identify their importance.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Introduce the concept of public services and ask students to brainstorm services they are familiar with.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students will share their ideas and discuss the importance of public services.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Provide examples of institutions that provide public services and ask students to describe their functions.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students will work in groups to research and present information about public services.
lesson_development_steps.assessment_and_feedback: Monitor group progress and provide feedback.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Have students present their findings and ask questions to clarify their understanding.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students will share their presentations and discuss the importance of public services.
lesson_development_steps.assessment_and_feedback: Provide feedback and ask students to reflect on their learning.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Facilitates student presentations and synthesis of findings from Step 3.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students present their findings, compare outcomes, and note teacher feedback.
lesson_development_steps.assessment_and_feedback: Teacher checks clarity of student presentations and corrects misconceptions.

summary: Recap the importance of public services and how they bring about quality development of human lives.
assessment_and_feedback_whole_lesson: Summative check on student understanding of public services.
post_activity: Have students create a visual representation of the public services they have learned about.
information_sources: National Institute of Education (NIE) Teacher Instructional Guide
